official.deadline_central_display: Applications are open year-round (rolling intake); no fixed closing date is published
official.deadline_note: No central deadline is published. After applying, applicants receive an email link to ILSC's Online English Placement Test, which must be completed by the deadline stated in that email.
official.application_cycle: Rolling intake - applications are open year-round; two scholarships per campus are available every three sessions
official.status_note: ILSC states applications are open year-round, with two scholarships per campus available every 3 sessions for newly arrived refugees near the Adelaide, Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne or Perth campuses.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The scholarships cover 11-12 weeks of English language study, all learning materials and resources, and administrative fees.
benefits: 11-12 weeks of English study program in groups, including General English, Exam Preparation and English for Academic Purposes
All learning materials and resources required for your classes
FREE Duolingo Premium for the duration of your scholarship, sponsored by Duolingo
Join multiple free events and clubs on campus, develop barista skills in the Cafe Work Skills course, and choose other selective courses in line with your interest
Scholarships are also available for online ILSC Hello courses for those who cannot attend in person
eligibility: Hold or be on a bridging visa for one of the following Australian humanitarian visas: 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851, 866
Be at least 18 years of age at the commencement of studies
Live within commuting distance of the ILSC-Adelaide, ILSC-Brisbane, ILSC-Melbourne, ILSC-Sydney, or ILSC-Perth campus
Not have received a Centrelink Relocation Grant
Not have received the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship before
requirements: Provide proof of Australian humanitarian or respective bridging visa
Complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test; Pre-intermediate or above is required
Maintain a minimum attendance of 80% during the program
Accept the scholarship offer within 48 hours or it will be withdrawn and offered to another candidate
Course selections and timetables are subject to availability upon enrollment; confirmed course start dates cannot be deferred
Scholarships cannot be exchanged for cash value or refunded
documents: Proof of Australian humanitarian visa or the respective bridging visa
Completed free ILSC Online English Placement Test result showing at least Pre-intermediate level
selection_criteria: Scholarship candidates will be selected by a committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools
Successful candidates will be offered the scholarship based on the earliest available date
ILSC does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, national origin, disability, age, gender, sexual orientation or religion
coverage: 11-12 weeks of English language study in groups (General English, Exam Preparation and English for Academic Purposes)
All learning materials and resources required for the classes
Duolingo Premium account for the duration of the placement (sponsored by Duolingo)
application_method: Submit the application form on the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship application page
Complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test using the link sent by ILSC, by the deadline mentioned in the email
Await selection by a committee of staff and teachers at the ILSC Australia schools
Accept the scholarship offer within 48 hours of receiving it
official.application_route: Apply online via the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship application form at ilsc.com; applications are open year-round.
official.study_mode: Full-time group classes: in-person morning 8:30am-1pm (T1), afternoon 1:15pm-5:15pm (T2) or evening 5:30-9:30pm (T3), or online 10am-2pm AEST via ILSC Hello
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must hold, or be on a bridging visa for, an Australian humanitarian visa (subclasses 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851 or 866) and live within commuting distance of ILSC-Adelaide, ILSC-Brisbane, ILSC-Melbourne, ILSC-Sydney or ILSC-Perth.
official.international_eligibility: Not open to international students applying from overseas; the scholarship is restricted to refugees living in Australia. Online ILSC Hello scholarships are available for those who cannot attend in person.
official.duration: 3 sessions of English language study (11-12 weeks); one session is 4 weeks, except for December
official.description: The ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship is designed to support refugees who are facing language barriers to accessing tertiary education or employment in Australia. It provides three sessions of English language study, covering all learning materials, resources and administrative fees, and was launched by ILSC after Refugee Week 2022 to help newly arrived refugees bridge the financial and educational gap.
official.program_type: English language study scholarship (ELICOS) offered by ILSC Language Schools Australia
official.english_requirement: Applicants must complete the free ILSC Online English Placement Test, with Pre-intermediate level or above required. The award is itself an English language program, so no higher English standard is required.

verification.notes: Verified on ILSC's own scholarship and application pages. The official pages publish no monetary value - the award is in-kind coverage of tuition (11-12 weeks of English study), materials, resources and administrative fees - and no fixed deadline (rolling year-round intake).

applicant_utility.summary: This is an in-kind tuition waiver, not a cash grant: ILSC covers 11-12 weeks of group English study (General English, exam preparation and EAP), all class materials and administrative fees, plus a free Duolingo Premium account. Only two scholarships per campus are released every three sessions at Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney and Perth, with an online ILSC Hello option for those who cannot attend in person. Because intake is rolling year-round, you can apply at any time, but competition is tight and offers can lapse fast. Plan to be reachable by email and ready to commit to an 80% attendance minimum once selected.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A newly arrived refugee aged 18 or over, living in Australia on a humanitarian or bridging visa within commuting distance of an ILSC campus.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your visa subclass in writing (200, 201, 202, 203, 204, 785, 790, 851 or 866, or a bridging visa for one of these) before applying, and keep the document ready to upload
Check your address against the campus list - Adelaide, Brisbane, Melbourne, Sydney or Perth - before submitting, since commuting distance is an eligibility rule
Sit ILSC's free Online English Placement Test early so you know whether you reach Pre-intermediate; study first if you score below it
Watch the inbox (including spam) for the test-link email after applying and complete the test by the date stated in it
Arrange to be reachable by phone and email for the 48-hour offer window, and block out a realistic study timetable that can sustain 80% attendance
common_rejection_risks: Scoring below Pre-intermediate on the placement test, which is an explicit eligibility threshold
Having received a Centrelink Relocation Grant, which disqualifies the application outright
Applying when the two-per-campus quota for the current three-session window is already filled, as offers go to the earliest available date
Missing the email or delaying response, so the offer is withdrawn and reallocated after 48 hours
Being a previous recipient of the ILSC Humanitarian Scholarship, which rules out a second award
Falling below 80% attendance mid-program, which breaches the scholarship terms
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation, transport to and from campus, and any personal or exam-related expenses are not covered; the award covers only tuition (English study), class materials/resources, administrative fees and the Duolingo Premium account. Budget for day-to-day costs in Australia during the 11-12 week placement.
document_audit: Visa evidence must match your exact subclass - an ImmiEviction or visa grant notice showing 200/201/202/203/204/785/790/851/866 or the bridging visa is the document ILSC asks for; a passport or residency letter alone will not prove it
The placement-test link arrives only after you apply, so the test step depends on an email reaching you - use an address you check daily and whitelist ilsc.com
Make sure the name on your application matches the name on your visa document exactly to avoid verification delays
alerts: Offers must be accepted within 48 hours or they are withdrawn and offered to another candidate - treat any ILSC email as time-critical
Confirmed start dates cannot be deferred, so do not accept an offer unless you can begin on that date
Course and timetable choices depend on availability and your English level; December sessions run on a different length than the usual four weeks
The award cannot be exchanged for cash or refunded, so it only has value if you can actually attend full-time classes
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the online application form, receive and complete the placement test link by the emailed deadline, then wait for the committee of ILSC Australia staff and teachers to select recipients for the earliest available start date; accept within 48 hours to secure the place.
